transcript.text: my oven fan keeps going after ive turned the oven off, been about 20 mins now. is it broken??

No, it is not broken. Most modern ovens have a cooling fan that continues to run for 10–30 minutes after you switch the oven off to cool down the internal electronics and prevent the exterior from getting too hot. Since yours has been running for about 20 minutes, this is normal behaviour. It should stop automatically once the oven has cooled sufficiently. If it is still running after an hour or so, or if it never stops even when the oven is completely cold, then there may be a fault with the fan thermostat or control board.

candidates: Faulty cooling fan thermostat or control board (low)

reading.symptom: fan keeps running after oven turned off for about 20 mins

plan: They asked: "is it broken??" - answer that first.
The fault they reported is: "fan keeps running after oven turned off for about 20 mins". Keep to it: never describe a symptom, result or state they have not told you.

Stage 1 (broad help): say what could cause this, most likely first, as possibilities rather than certainties, including simple causes (settings, loading, detergent, installation, or normal behaviour) where they fit. Then give the one or two safe checks, or the one question, that would best tell those causes apart. Do not ask for the model number in this reply. Do not tell them to buy, order or replace a part yet.
